strings.소문 많이 들었어요!: I've heard so much about you!
strings.아무리 어려운 일도 마다하지 않고 쉽게 해결한다고 하는 모험가 %s!: The adventurer %s, who never turns down a difficult job and makes even the toughest tasks look easy!
strings.아무튼, 실력 있는 모험가라는 게 중요하지요!: Anyway, what matters is that you're a capable adventurer!
I'm Keise, an archaeologist studying the ruins here on Merin Island.
But a mad scientist called Dr. SD suddenly showed up and took over the ruins.
strings.미친 과학자? SD는 이름 약자인가요?: A mad scientist? Are SD his initials?
Something like Sund... I don't even want to know...
He brought an excavation team and a whole mercenary company to occupy the ruins.
strings.그리고 마구 파헤치면서 훼손시키고 있단 말이에요!: And now they're digging everything up and damaging the site!
strings.유적지를 망가뜨리려고 하다니…!: How dare they try to destroy these ruins...!
strings.그들을 쫓아내 주면 되는 건가요?: So you want me to drive them out?
Yes! They're trespassing and looting the place indiscriminately...
strings.그뿐만 아니라 저들 때문에 몬스터까지 몰려오고 있단 말이에요!: And on top of that, they've drawn monsters here too!
strings.계속 두면 이곳은 난장판이 될 거예요!: If we leave them alone, this whole place will be a disaster!
I see. All right. I'll take care of it.
strings.일 처리 화끈하게 부탁드려요!: Please give them a proper thrashing!
The rumors don't even do you justice.
strings.그동안 날고 긴다는 사람들을 봤지만, 이렇게 잘 싸우는 분은 처음 봤어요: I've met plenty of people who were supposed to be the best, but I've never seen anyone fight like you.
I suppose I've improved a little along the way...
strings.거짓말! 이게 조금 는 게 이 정도면, 더 늘면 어떻다는 건가요?!: You're kidding! If this is only a little improvement, what will you be like when you improve even more?!
Anyway, I've cleared the area around the ruins, so I'll head inside now.
If there's anything you want to tell me, now's the time.
strings.하고 싶은 말이요?: Anything I want to tell you?
Please be careful not to damage the ruins.
strings.아직 세상 밖으로 나오지 않은 유물과 보물들이많거든요. 분명, 나중에 이: There are still so many undiscovered artifacts and treasures here. One day, they'll surely help us understand this world's ancient history.
Yes. I'll be as careful as I can.
strings.저 이곳에 있을 테니까 문제 발생하면 찾아와 주세요!: I'll be here, so come find me if anything goes wrong!
Dr. SD is known as a mad scientist in those circles.
Apparently, his family was killed by members of another race...
After that, he began pouring all his efforts into scientific research to get revenge.
So he has his own reasons.
strings.세상에 사연 없는 사람이 어디 있겠어요?: Who in this world doesn't have a story of their own?
Since then, he's been traveling from ruin to ruin...
Collecting mysterious powers that science can't explain and turning them into weapons.
They say that's how he built the bizarre machine he rides around in.
Then perhaps I should just scare him off.
He hasn't committed any truly terrible crimes...
strings.저 인간이 얼마나 많은 유적지를 훼손시켰는데요?!: Do you have any idea how many ruins that man has damaged?!
strings.그게 얼마나 큰 죄인데…: Do you know what a serious crime that is...
strings.고고학자 아니라고 말씀을 너무 함부로 하시네요!: Just because you're not an archaeologist doesn't mean you can say such careless things!
Teach him a lesson so he'll never dare come near this place again.
I know I can be a bit difficult...
Dealing with me must have been frustrating...
Anyway, it looks like everything has been sorted out...
So you can focus on your research now.
Contact me if anything else comes up.
strings.어머, 또 도와주실 건가요?: Oh my, you'd help me again?
I believe in providing good follow-up service.
strings.아무튼, 수고 많으셨어요!: Anyway, thank you for all your hard work!
